recommendations.title: Switch Fixture Fund Regular → Direct plan
recommendations.why: You hold the same scheme in two plans. The Regular plan charges ~1.8% p.a. vs ~0.5% for Direct — identical portfolio, higher fees. Switching saves ₹1,950/yr.
recommendations.action: Redeem Fixture Fund Regular (₹150,000) and invest in Fixture Fund Direct.

caveats.text: LTCG at 10% on units held > 1 year (above ₹1 L annual exemption). STCG at 15% on units held < 1 year.
ELSS units are locked for 3 years per instalment — switch only unlocked units.

recommendations.title: Reduce Fixture AMC from 40.6% → ~25.0%
recommendations.why: Fixture AMC is 40.6% of your mutual-fund portfolio — 15.6pt above the 30% cap.
recommendations.action: Redeem ₹156,000 from Fixture Fund Regular (largest Fixture AMC holding).
recommendations.redeploy_to: Redeploy into an AMC currently below 10% of your portfolio.
